# Review screen: final diff with line, file and general comments

## What to build

While a run waits for a human review (review step `human`; `store.getState().review?.waiting` in the web server; spec `docs/prd/06-human-review-round.md` §7.3, §10), the web view shows the **final diff** (run's starting commit → integration branch head) and lets the user write comments:

- a **line comment**: click a line number on the new side of a diff → inline textarea; anchored to `file`, `line` and a `snippet` (that line plus up to 2 lines before it, from the rendered diff);
- a **file comment**: "Comment on file" button in a file row;
- a **general comment**: a textarea under the banner.

Each comment has `body` (required) and `liveCheck` (checkbox "needs live check", default off). Comments of the current round can be edited and deleted. Every change is written to `.graph-execution/<run-id>/human/round<H>.json` **before** the HTTP response, so a restart (`--resume`) shows the same drafts. This slice does not send comments anywhere yet (Request changes is a later slice).

## Context: files to read before implementing

- What already exists (from the pause slice):
  - `src/state/state.ts` — review step `"human"`, `humanRound` (1-based number of the current pause), `budgetBase`.
  - `src/review/phase.ts` — `case "human"` emits `review:waiting { round, blocking }` and waits on `opts.human.wait()`. `ReviewPhaseOptions` (41-63) has `runDir`, `repo`, `integrationBranch`, `startingCommit`.
  - `src/web/server.ts` — `readJson(req)` body reader, Origin check for every non-GET method, `review?: Pick<RetryHub, "decide">` option, `GET /review` → `{ round, blocking }`, `POST /review/apply|drop`; 409 helper when not waiting; `known` paths list (around 187) for 405 vs 404; `changesRoute` (146-156) only serves files in the node's change list (else 400).
  - `src/web/page.html` — `#review` banner rendered from `s.review`.
- `src/git/git.ts` — `rangeChanges(repo, from, to)` (287-293) → `ChangedFile[]` sorted by path; `rangeFileDiff(repo, from, to, file)` (296-298). `ChangedFile` is in `src/runner/events.ts` (29-38).
- `src/runner/changes.ts` — `FileDiff { path, diff, truncated, binary }` (10-16), `DIFF_CAP_BYTES` (17), `capDiff` (22-30, **not exported**: export it), `fileDiff` (76-99: numstat `-\t-` means binary).
- `src/web/page.html` — KAN-7 diff code: `diffLine(cls, oldNo, newNo, mark, content)` (350-356), `fillDiff(pre, data, path)` (358-384, tracks `newNo`), `loadDiff` (385-402, `row.seq` drops stale responses, cache `diffs`), `makeRow(id, f)` (406-432), `countsText` (403), `highlight` (336-349), button pattern in `failureSection` (284-315).
- `src/ui/start.tsx` `UiOptions` (10-35) — has no `runDir`/`repo`; `src/runner/run.ts` builds it at line 319 (`opts.ui?.({...})`); `src/web/start.ts` passes options to `createWebServer`.
- `src/graph/testPlan.ts` (8-15) — zod schema style to mirror.
- Tests: `src/web/server.test.ts` `setup()` (15-26), `post(...)`/`rawRequest` (28-37), `describe("GET /changes/:id")` (255-294, path traversal → 400).

## Patterns to follow

**New module `src/review/human.ts`** (later slices import these exact names):
```ts
export const HUMAN_DIR = "human";
export const commentSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string().regex(/^H\d+-\d+$/),          // H<round>-<n>, e.g. H1-2
  round: z.number().int().min(1),
  file: z.string().min(1).optional(),
  line: z.number().int().min(1).optional(),     // new-side line; only with file
  snippet: z.string().max(2000).optional(),
  body: z.string().trim().min(1).max(10_000),
  liveCheck: z.boolean().default(false),
  status: z.enum(["open", "resolved", "reopened"]).default("open"),
  followUps: z.array(z.string().min(1)).default([]),
});
export type Comment = z.infer<typeof commentSchema>;
export const humanRoundSchema = z.object({
  round: z.number().int().min(1),
  diffBase: z.string().min(1),
  diffHead: z.string().min(1),
  comments: z.array(commentSchema),
});
export type HumanRound = z.infer<typeof humanRoundSchema>;
export const humanRoundPath = (runDir: string, round: number) => path.join(runDir, HUMAN_DIR, `round${round}.json`);
export async function loadHumanRound(runDir: string, round: number): Promise<HumanRound | undefined>;
export async function saveHumanRound(runDir: string, data: HumanRound): Promise<void>; // tmp file + rename, like StateStore.save
export async function startHumanRound(runDir: string, round: number, diffBase: string, diffHead: string): Promise<HumanRound>; // keeps an existing file (resume)
export async function allComments(runDir: string, upToRound: number): Promise<Comment[]>; // rounds 1..upTo, in order
/** Serializes edits per run dir; every method saves before resolving. */
export class HumanReviewStore {
  constructor(runDir: string);
  current(): Promise<HumanRound>;                         // file of the highest round
  add(input: { file?; line?; snippet?; body; liveCheck? }): Promise<Comment>; // id = H<round>-<max n + 1>
  edit(id: string, patch: { body?: string; liveCheck?: boolean }): Promise<Comment>; // current round only
  remove(id: string): Promise<void>;                       // current round only
}
```
Errors for unknown ids / earlier-round edits: throw a `HumanReviewError` with a message; the server maps it to 400 (unknown → 404).

**Phase:** when `phase.ts` enters the `human` case, call `startHumanRound(opts.runDir, progress.humanRound, opts.startingCommit, await revParse(opts.repo, opts.integrationBranch))` before emitting `review:waiting` (`revParse` is already used at phase.ts ~139).

**Routes** (all 409 unless waiting):
- `GET /review` → existing fields + `files: ChangedFile[]` (from `rangeChanges(repo, diffBase, diffHead)`) + `comments: Comment[]` (`allComments(runDir, round)`) + `diffBase`, `diffHead`.
- `GET /review/diff?file=<path>&round=<H>` → `FileDiff` of that round's `diffBase..diffHead`; 400 if `file` isn't in that round's `rangeChanges` (same guard as `changesRoute`).
- `POST /review/comments` → body as above → 201 with the comment. `line` without `file` → 400.
- `PUT /review/comments/<id>` / `DELETE /review/comments/<id>` → 200 / 404 / 400.
- Server options: `human?: { runDir: string; repo: string }`. Add `runDir` and `repo` to `UiOptions`, set them in `run.ts` where it calls `opts.ui?.({...})` (line 319), and pass them through `startWebUi` → `createWebServer`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `src/review/human.ts` (+ `src/review/human.test.ts`)
- **IMPLEMENT**: schemas, path helpers, load/save/start, `allComments`, `HumanReviewStore`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/review/human.test.ts` — ids increment per round, edit/delete of an earlier round's comment throws, a reload from disk returns the same data, concurrent `add` calls get distinct ids.

### UPDATE `src/runner/changes.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `export` `capDiff`.

### UPDATE `src/review/phase.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `startHumanRound` on entering `human` (idempotent for resume).

### UPDATE `src/ui/start.tsx`, `src/runner/run.ts`, `src/web/start.ts`, `src/web/server.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `runDir`/`repo` plumbing, the routes, `/review/` prefix handling for `/review/comments/<id>` (decode like `/changes/`), add to `known`.
- **GOTCHA**: write before responding; map zod errors to 400 with the first issue's message.

### UPDATE `src/web/page.html`
- **IMPLEMENT**: when `s.review?.waiting`, fetch `GET /review` once per round (and after each comment change) and render below the banner:
  - a general comment box (textarea + "needs live check" + Save);
  - the file list using `makeRow`-style rows whose diff loader calls `/review/diff?file=..&round=..` instead of `/changes/...`; reuse `fillDiff`;
  - in review diffs, new-side line numbers are clickable → inline form under that line; snippet = text of that line and up to 2 previous lines of the same hunk;
  - a "Comment on file" button per row;
  - comments shown inline under their line/file, general ones in a list; each with Edit / Delete for the current round.
- **GOTCHA**: `fillDiff` is shared with the node panel; add an optional callback parameter for line clicks rather than changing its existing behavior.

### ADD server tests (`src/web/server.test.ts`)
- 409 before waiting; add → 201 and file on disk; line without file → 400; PUT/DELETE; unknown id → 404; `/review/diff` with a file not in the diff → 400; DELETE with a foreign Origin → 403.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `GET /review` lists the final diff's files and all comments while waiting
- [ ] Line, file and general comments can be added, edited and deleted in the current round
- [ ] Each change is in `human/round<H>.json` before the response
- [ ] After a restart and `--resume`, the drafts are still there
- [ ] Comment ids are `H<round>-<n>`
- [ ] Invalid input → 400; unknown id → 404; not waiting → 409; foreign Origin → 403
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npx vitest run src/review/human.test.ts src/web src/review/phase.test.ts
npm run build && npx vitest run src/web-e2e.test.ts
```
